# Support

For OpenHarmony compiler, build or runtime issues, use this repository's issue form after reading [the platform limits](../ohos/docs/platform.md). Include the source revision, downstream Go identity, host, SDK, target API and a minimal redacted reproduction.

This is a community preview without an SLA. Sensitive findings belong in [private security reports](https://github.com/flypigJ/go-ohos/security/advisories/new), not public issues. Upstream Go issues should first be reproduced with an official Go toolchain.
